svg.text: Island Colony controller: ONE big breadboard
ESP32 across the middle gap: TOP pins in row b, BOTTOM pins in row i. Row a (above) and row j (below) stay free: that is where the wires go.
Parts sit outside the box: female end of each wire on the part, male end in the breadboard.
220 Ω: D27 row a → column 3 row a
TOP pins → wire in ROW a:
BOTTOM pins → wire in ROW j:
Joystick +5V goes to 3V3, never 5 V. If the ESP32 hides row a or row j, tell me before wiring.
